statBlock.name: Arch-hag
statBlock.description: An ancient hag whose curses spread beyond her lair. Choose what she hates most before an encounter. That anathema determines where the characters can kill her.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). On a failed saving throw, the hag can spend one use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spiteful Escape. At 0 HP, the hag dies if she is within 30 ft. of her anathema, the thing she hates most as chosen by the DM. Outside that range she drops to 1 HP, teleports to a harmless demiplane, and cannot return to the plane she left for 2d6 days. Every creature within 60 ft. of the space she left becomes cursed. Each cursed creature has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws. The hag knows each cursed creature's location anywhere in the multiverse until its curse ends.
sections.Coven Magic: While within 30 ft. of at least two allied hags, she can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. Use each spell's normal casting time, omit Material components, and use Intelligence with spell save DC 19. Each spell recovers its use after a Long Rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spectral Claw attacks and use Crackling Wave.
Spectral Claw. Melee or ranged attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) Force damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Crackling Wave. Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. Failure deals 32 (5d12) Lightning damage. Success halves the damage. Either outcome curses the creature until the end of the hag's next turn. The creature cannot take Reactions while this curse lasts.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 22) and omitting Material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Dispel Magic, Hypnotic Pattern.
2/day each. Mass Suggestion, Modify Memory, Plane Shift.
sections.Bonus actions: Witch Strike. Every creature within 60 ft. that the hag has cursed takes 14 (4d6) Lightning damage.
sections.Reactions: Tongue Twister. Cast Counterspell on its normal trigger using Charisma (save DC 22). If the target fails its save, it becomes cursed until the end of its next turn. While this curse lasts it cannot cast spells with Verbal components, and its speech expresses the opposite of what it means.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in the hag's lair. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The hag recovers spent uses at the start of her turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Hag's Swipe. Make one Spectral Claw attack.
Malicious Magic. Use Spellcasting to cast Dimension Door or Hypnotic Pattern. This option is unavailable again until the start of the hag's next turn.
sections.In its lair: 41,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 5/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Lapsus Linguae. Within 1 mile of the lair, creatures other than the hag and her allies subtract 1d10 from ability checks made as part of the Influence action.
Meddlesome Magic. When a creature other than the hag or an ally finishes a Long Rest within 1 mile of the lair, its next spell cast with a spell slot also casts Confusion centered on that creature. Confusion uses the creature's spellcasting ability and requires no Concentration.
Both effects end immediately when the arch-hag is destroyed or relocates her lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 20–21. The stat block is on p. 21 and the regional effects are on p. 20.

statBlock.name: Blob of Annihilation
statBlock.description: A colossal ooze that engulfs prey and debris alike. Destroying its body sends whatever it has engulfed into the Astral Sea.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Astral Implosion. At 0 HP, the blob implodes, sending engulfed creatures and objects to the Astral Sea. It vanishes and coats everything that was within 600 ft. with slime. It reforms on a random world on the Material Plane in 1d20 years.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). On a failed saving throw, the blob can spend one use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. The blob has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Engulf. One Pseudopod attack can be replaced with Restraining Glob.
Pseudopod. Melee attack, +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. A hit deals 24 (3d10 + 8) Force damage.
Engulf. Move up to the blob's Speed, passing through spaces occupied by Huge or smaller creatures or objects. Each target makes a DC 23 Strength save the first time the blob enters its space during this move. Failure engulfs the target. Engulfed targets move with the blob and have Total Cover against attacks and effects outside it. A nonmagical object is destroyed after 1 minute inside. An engulfed creature is Restrained and suffocating, takes 21 (6d6) Force damage at the start of each of its turns, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. If it drops to 0 HP while engulfed, it dissolves into ash and the blob ejects the ash into the Astral Sea. On a successful save, the target escapes to the nearest unoccupied space.
Restraining Glob. Choose one visible Large or smaller creature within 600 ft. It makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 18 (3d6 + 8) Acid damage, rolls 60 ft. straight toward the blob, and is Restrained until the end of its next turn, when the glob dissolves harmlessly. Success halves the damage and avoids the movement and restraint.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The blob recovers spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Decay. Each creature engulfed by the blob takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. The blob cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.
Grasping Glob. Use Restraining Glob. The blob cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.
Lashing Goop. Make one Pseudopod attack.

statBlock.name: Elemental Cataclysm
statBlock.speed: 60 ft., burrow 60 ft., fly 80 ft. (hover), swim 80 ft.
statBlock.description: A titan of the Elemental Chaos. It moves through earth, air, and water and can set off a different disaster each time it attacks with Cataclysmic Event.

sections.Damage immunities: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. The cataclysm can burrow through unworked, nonmagical earth and stone without disturbing the material.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). On a failed saving throw, the cataclysm can spend one use to succeed.
Siege Monster. The cataclysm deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Elemental Burst attacks.
Elemental Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. or range 150 ft. A hit deals 25 (5d6 + 8) damage. The cataclysm chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder for that hit.
Control Weather. Cast Control Weather using Constitution and no spell components.
Cataclysmic Event (recharge 4–6). Roll 1d4 for one effect.
1. Clinging Flames. Center a 60-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 150 ft. Each creature inside makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 45 (13d6) Fire damage. Success halves the damage. The creature starts Burning either way.
2. Freezing Waves. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 23 Strength save. Failure deals 22 (5d8) Bludgeoning plus 22 (5d8) Cold damage and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and avoids the fall. Either way, the creature's Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
3. Raging Storm. Center a 60-ft.-radius sphere of storm cloud on a visible point within 150 ft. It lasts for 1 minute or until the cataclysm uses Cataclysmic Event again. Creatures wholly inside are Blinded and Deafened and cannot cast spells with Verbal components. A creature that first enters the cloud on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) Lightning plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage. Success halves the damage.
4. Swallowing Earth. Choose a point on the ground within 150 ft. Each creature in a 90-ft. cube originating there makes a DC 23 Strength save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) Acid damage, knocks it Prone, and buries it under rubble. Success halves the damage and avoids the fall and burial. A buried creature is Restrained and suffocating and has Total Cover. The buried creature or another creature within 5 ft. of it can take an action to free it with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The cataclysm recovers spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Eruption. Make one Elemental Burst attack.
Rumbling Movement. Move up to the cataclysm's Speed, Fly Speed, or Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature it comes within 5 ft. of during the move makes one DC 23 Constitution save or falls Prone. The cataclysm cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.

statBlock.name: Cyclops Oracle
statBlock.description: A one-eyed giant who uses divination to track what matters to its community. In a fight it can blindside opponents with flashes of light and replace a roll with a glimpse of the future.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Radiant Strike or Flash of Light in any combination.
Radiant Strike. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) Radiant damage.
Flash of Light. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) Radiant damage and gives the target Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the cyclops's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 16) and omitting Material components.
2/day each. Arcane Eye, Detect Magic, Locate Object.
1/day. Legend Lore.
sections.Reactions: Portent (recharge 4–6). When the cyclops or an ally it can see makes a D20 Test, roll 1d20. The cyclops may substitute its roll for the test's d20.
sections.Habitats: Coastal, desert, grassland, hill, mountain, underdark.

statBlock.name: Cyclops Sentry
statBlock.description: A one-eyed giant who guards a settlement or its approach. A sudden glimpse of an incoming strike helps it turn the attack back on its foe.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Stone Club or Rock in any combination.
Stone Club. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Rock. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Limited Foresight (recharge 6). When a visible creature makes an attack roll against the cyclops, impose Disadvantage on the roll. The cyclops gains Advantage on attacks against that creature until the end of the cyclops's next turn.
sections.Habitats: Coastal, desert, grassland, hill, mountain, underdark.
